status: From secondary 2026 guides that cite Sri Lanka Customs / IRD / TRCSL. VERIFY against the official Sri Lanka Customs tariff guide before final use.
sources: https://induwara.lk/tools/sri-lanka-mobile-phone-import-tax-calculator (updated 2026-05-16; cites Sri Lanka Customs Tariff Guide HS 8517.13/8517.14, IRD VAT, IRD SSCL, TRCSL MDRS)
order: CID, PAL and CESS on CIF; SSCL on CIF+CID+PAL+CESS; VAT on CIF+CID+PAL+CESS+SSCL; fixed fees added last
cif_note: CIF = item price + shipping (insurance ignored), converted to LKR with the snapshot exchange rate (Customs uses the CBSL rate of the entry date).

phones.fixed_fee_note: TRCSL MDRS registration Rs 200 + 18% VAT per IMEI (single-SIM; skipped if already allow-listed)
